name: Frost Goliath

traits.name: Frost's Chill
traits.description: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can deal an additional 1d6 Cold damage to that target and reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. You can do so a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

alternateStrikeMode.name: Frost Strike
alternateStrikeMode.description: Instead of the usual unconditional 10-foot Speed reduction from Frost's Chill, on a qualifying melee or thrown-weapon hit that deals damage you can use the same single 1d6 Cold damage rider and require a Constitution saving throw. On failure the creature's Speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn. On success no Speed reduction occurs. Spend one existing Frost's Chill use, not an additional use.

traits.name: Born of Ice
traits.description: You have 50 percent resistance to Cold damage.

traits.name: Frigid Retaliation
traits.description: Immediately after a creature you can see within 30 feet hits you with an attack roll and damages you, you can use your Reaction to require it to make a Constitution saving throw. On failure it takes 1d8 plus Proficiency Bonus Cold damage and has Speed 0 until the end of its next turn; on success it suffers neither effect. Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest.

reviewNotes: SRD 5.2.1 Giant Ancestry adapted into one selectable Subspecies, not six independent options granted to every Goliath.
Inherits Powerful Build, Large Form, size and Speed from species.goliath; the chosen ancestry boon uses Proficiency Bonus activations per Long Rest.
Effects are a coherent first-pass baseline and remain open to future reconciliation and playtesting.

Selected for first-pass playtesting: each ancestry's Strike-derived early mode is merged with the SRD boon instead of granting an independent Strike of the Giants feat; Fire's Burn already contains Fire Strike.

Early Strike modes share the original ancestry's Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest and never grant an extra use pool. Modes with Bigby's weapon-hit restriction retain that restriction; core SRD boons are not narrowed.

Advanced inherited features unlock at total character level 4. Their source-feat prerequisites and +1 Ability Score Increase are not additional grants; save/attack modifiers use the Goliath's selected giant ancestry aptitude.
Other feats, rune training and giant cultural backgrounds remain independent options and are not automatically provided by Species inheritance.

frost Goliath's advanced features were adapted from the corresponding *Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants* giant feat; cultural and rune feats remain separate. No feat or ability-score-increase entitlement is awarded.
